title: Heading into Sunday's game, Jalen Johnson is 28 for 98 …
text:
Heading into Sunday's game, Jalen Johnson is 28 for 98 … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS Heading into Sunday's game, Jalen Johnson is 28 for 98 …
 HoopsHype Nov. 15, 2026, 4:43 p.m. ET Brad Rowland: Heading into Sunday's game, Jalen Johnson is 28 for 98 on all shot attempts outside of 4 feet. That is 28.6% . For reference, he shot 39.5% on those shots last season. Massive difference that is holding back his efficiency (and the team's).
